method: Static ELF disassembly, rodata inspection, pinned-source reading, and analytic binary32 range proof only; no builds, tests, native library calls, or arithmetic enumeration/simulation.
conclusion: For every frame center actually computed in the specified domain, analysis, private periodic overlap-add, and private basis export yield exactly 120*i. The source-level round-versus-truncate center-mismatch uncertainty is closed for these compiled paths in both specified ELFs, not inferred solely from the two previously saved trace centers.

static_evidence.cross_binary_comparison: Complete objdump -d -Mintel disassemblies of llsm_harmonic_analysis, sc_periodic, and llsm_sc_export_periodic_basis_v1 were compared and identical after excluding the filename header. Relevant inspected constants are also identical.

static_evidence.private_multiplier: rodata 0x4cc78: bytes 00 00 f0 42, binary32 bits 0x42f00000 = exactly 120
static_evidence.caller_hop: llsm_sc_analyze 0x1c0a3 stores immediate 0x3ba3d70a in options.thop; llsm_analyze_harmonics 0x13152 loads options.thop into xmm1 before call at 0x13157

proof: The exact real product of binary32 0.005f and exactly representable 24000 is 120 - 45*2^-24. Its distance below 120 is less than half a binary32 ULP at 120 (2^-18), so round-to-nearest mulss produces exactly 120.

Every integer index 0..1200 and every integer product 120*i through 144000 is exactly representable in binary32. Thus the subsequent analysis multiplication and both private multiplications give exact 120*i under nearest rounding.

For positive products the analysis adds 0.5 - 2^-25 and converts by truncation. Throughout the bounded range the rounded sum remains at least 120*i and less than 120*i+1, so the stored center is 120*i; i=0 also gives center zero. Both private paths truncate exact 120*i directly.

Directed SSE rounding modes do not reopen an integer-center mismatch: the hoisted product can only be 120 or 120-2^-17. The frame-product deficit is bounded by 1200*2^-17 plus one maximum ULP (2^-6), less than 0.025 sample. After adding the positive approximately-0.5 bias, even allowing another full 2^-6 ULP for addition, the result remains strictly between 120*i and 120*i+1 for i>0. Private products remain exact. This is a mathematical bound, not a runtime rounding-mode observation.
limitations: Limited to the identified binaries, emitted paths, fixed parameters, and stated frame-index domain; not a portable assertion about left-associated source arithmetic or arbitrary builds.
Analysis allocates/computes centers for voiced frames; the conclusion concerns computed centers and does not assert execution reaches or succeeds at every frame for every input.
No new execution or measurement was performed. No proof of whole-run equivalence, original all-run equivalence, harmonic/phase-value equality, synthesis quality, or listening quality is implied.
Equal integer anchoring does not independently establish all other phase conventions or signal processing behavior.
open_loop_status: closed: this bounded compiled center-mismatch question requires no additional runtime observation
